title: FRED monthly z-score shift(1L) improves metrics — C11 fix validates alpha
lesson: Applying shift(n=1L, type='lag') to FRED-derived monthly signals (fred_exposure, n_sig) to enforce C11 PIT compliance IMPROVED all key metrics: SR 1.099->1.111, CAGR 14.31->14.48%, MDD 28.16->27.12%. This confirms the alpha is NOT driven by FRED look-ahead. When a C11 fix improves performance, it strongly validates the underlying alpha source — the look-ahead noise was actually hurting the signal, not helping it. This is the strongest possible evidence that the strategy's alpha (foreign investor flow conditioning + idiovol/beta/consensus) is genuine.
implications: C11 fix improving metrics = strong alpha validation signal
FRED cross-asset overlay adds value even with proper 1-month lag
Foreign flow momentum z-score is a legitimate alpha source independent of FRED timing
Consensus data (SUE/ESBR) same-month lookup is valid for real-time analyst estimates (distinct from C4 accounting lag)
gate_result: GRADE A — all 6 gates pass, C11 fully clean
